competency: Inspect an unfamiliar small ROOT dataset, derive one useful quantity, apply a selection and produce an interpretable histogram plus cutflow.
acceptance: The prompt states the scientific/data goal but not the exact ROOT sequence; tests validate selection and outputs.

competency: Diagnose a plausible analysis whose result is wrong because of a cut boundary, histogram range or eager execution choice.
acceptance: The learner identifies the causal defect from observable outputs rather than filling missing syntax.

competency: Reuse one compact analysis across two samples, compare their selected distributions and explain one meaningful difference.
acceptance: The same analysis logic is applied to both deterministic samples and tests verify comparable outputs without prescribing the implementation sequence.
